title: Subcutaneous Injection in Adult Mice
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Subcutaneous Injection in an Adult Mouse
Injectable substance, as described in approved IACUC protocol
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Return injectable reagent to appropriate storage location.

steps.title: Verify Animal Identity
steps.instruction: Retrieve the adult mouse from the designated space and verify that the cage card number and LabTracks ID match the LabTracks task.

substeps.instruction: Double check cage number, LabTracks ID, ear notches, sex, and tattoos against the LabTracks task.

steps.title: Determine Dosage
steps.instruction: Determine the correct dose based on the animal's weight.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the animal or confirm the weight previously recorded on the cage card.
Consult the dosing chart to verify the dose appropriate for the animal's weight.

steps.title: Prepare the Syringe
steps.instruction: Fill a sterile disposable syringe (Luer-Lok Tip with sterile needle or attached needle, sized appropriately) with the specified injectable compound.

substeps.instruction: If the substance is in a bottle with a rubber stopper, wipe the top with an alcohol wipe before inserting the needle.
Fill the syringe with the appropriate amount of compound, adding a little extra.
Invert and flick the syringe gently to remove bubbles.
Expel extra solution until the exact dosing volume is achieved.
Cap needles using a recapper when transporting syringes.

steps.title: Restrain the Animal
steps.instruction: Place the mouse on a surface where it can gain traction and manually restrain it.

substeps.instruction: Hold the tail in one hand.
Pinch the target skin (typically at the back of the neck or towards the posterior end of the body) with the other hand.

steps.title: Administer Subcutaneous Injection
steps.instruction: Inject the substance into the subcutaneous space.

substeps.instruction: Insert the needle into the tent of skin to a depth of approximately 2-3 mm.
Keep the needle parallel with the mouse's body to avoid penetrating muscle tissue or hitting the spine.
Press the plunger with moderate pressure and speed to prevent tissue damage.
Remove the syringe/needle from the mouse.

steps.title: Post-Injection Handling
steps.instruction: Return the animal to its housing and document the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse back into the cage.
Record the substance, route, volume, date, time, and initials of the person performing the injection on the cage card and LabTracks task.
Return the cage to the originating rack and check that the QD is functioning properly.

steps.title: Final Documentation and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Complete administrative records and sanitize the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Verify that the lot number of the substance is identified and recorded on the LabTracks task.
Clean the work area with approved disinfectant.
Dispose of the syringe/needle in an approved biohazard sharps disposal container (do not re-cap used needles; do not fill container more than 2/3 full).
Retain all expired or unused legend drugs for disposal by Stericycle or other authorized Reverse Distributor.
